name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.contactkit.ui.fun.addfriend.FunAddFriendActivity
description: When a user opens Add Friend and looks up an account, the NetEase Yunxin ContactKit UI SDK finds that person and opens their profile so the user can decide whether to add them.
disableEffect: Users can no longer look up an account or open its profile through ContactKit's Add Friend flow.
